purpose: Provide an executable two-interval fixture-local YYZ source-to-result composition with committed-observation altitude guidance, bounded pitch-moment control, ideal moment realization and structured precommit failure projections.

provenance.notes: The repository owner accepted fixture-local source composition, boundary-by-boundary lookup recomputation, committed-observation altitude PD guidance, bounded pitch-moment PD control, unit-gain zero-delay ideal moment realization, atomic rigid/mass commit, one-step RK4 with explicit substep convergence evidence, terminal-observation-first result semantics and fixture-local structured failure projection. The controlled trajectory proves formula, sign, saturation and current-cycle-to-interval causality without establishing canonical tuning, surface allocation, actuator dynamics, stability or overshoot. Diagnostic fact, policy decision and failed step outcome remain separate; stable codes are scoped to this fixture and do not allocate a product registry. The supplied-force two-interval trajectory remains a separate temporal oracle.

expected_facts.claim: Every required scientific role resolves once to an executable fixture and matching oracle/model identity before numerical composition begins.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Roles and identities are exact; declaration order is irrelevant.

expected_facts.claim: Each lookup-composed rigid candidate and scalar-burn mass candidate remains pending through its interval and becomes visible together at tick 1 or tick 2; interval 1 reads only the tick-1 committed state.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Commit, tick, identity, visibility and mass handoff are exact; physical state values use the declared formula tolerance.

expected_facts.claim: The tick-1 committed rigid and mass state drives a fresh air-data, trilinear aero, dimensionalization, propulsion and Closure evaluation; the held second-interval closure advances the full rotating state with one RK4 step.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Formula values use the declared absolute/relative tolerance; the 1/2/4/8 substep series must retain at least a 12-fold successive error reduction, with its separately declared ratio tolerance.

expected_facts.claim: The tick-1 committed altitude, vertical speed, pure-pitch attitude and pitch rate produce a bounded 0.04 rad pitch command and a 20 N·m moment command; unit-gain zero-delay realization adds that +B-y moment to Closure only over the following interval.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Source commit, ticks, identities, limits, saturation flags and validity interval are exact; formula, trajectory and control-effect differences use the declared numeric tolerances, including the separately declared convergence-ratio tolerance.

expected_facts.claim: Committed-boundary metrics select the higher-priority simultaneous completion at tick 2, seal the terminal observation against that commit and then freeze the mission result.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Decision, priority, event order, commit reference and seal state are exact; metrics use the declared formula tolerance.

expected_facts.claim: Stale Closure timing, non-atomic rigid/mass candidates and an out-of-domain Mach query each produce a fixture-local diagnostic fact, a separate policy decision and a failed precommit outcome that preserves the base commit, tick and committed mass.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Diagnostic identity, code, component identity, sample tick, policy linkage and rollback state are exact; numeric context uses the declared formula tolerance.

acceptance: One command resolves the current scientific components and produces three committed samples, two independently recomputed interval fact sets, metrics, terminal observation and mission result

Independent Python and C++17 implementations confirm the bounded guidance/control values, realized Closure moment, controlled second-interval fourth-order self-convergence and identity, timing, visibility, sign, saturation, stale-Closure, commit and result-order regressions
Three structured precommit failures carry stable fixture codes, component identity, sample tick, numeric context and rollback proof while keeping fact and policy separate
The bundle introduces no product Mission, Compiler, Session, Observation, Diagnostic or Artifact capability
